Class MoleculeStore.CompiledSnapshot

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.molecule.MoleculeStore.CompiledSnapshot
All Implemented Interfaces:
MoleculeStore.Lookup
Enclosing class:

public static final class MoleculeStore.CompiledSnapshot extends Object implements MoleculeStore.Lookup
Immutable matching data; only this store can construct a trusted compiled snapshot.
